title: LMID-conformally-flat-puncture: certified parametric conformally flat puncture initial data
description: Source code of lemaitre.initial_data.conformally_flat_puncture: a spectral solver for conformally flat Bowen-York puncture initial data and the certified, differentiable, parametric reduced-order models built on it. The trained models are archived separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24219765).
